menu_options.v2_migrate: Move an existing Local charger to V2

legacy_local.description: Configuration of name and external entities.

data.ev_soc_sensor: EV SoC entity (optional; no automatic charging without known demand)
data.ev_target_soc_sensor: EV Target SOC entity (single space to remove)
data.charger_entity: Charger control entity (single space to remove)
data.charging_state_entity: Charging state entity (single space to remove)
data.ev_controlled: An EV integration will control start/stop of charging

data.name: Vehicle name (required)
data.ready_by: Ready by — specific date and time (one-time)

data_description.ready_mode: Daily is the default. In the weekly calendar, blank days have no deadline.
data_description.soc_entity: Optional for manual or kWh/time charging. Required for OEM SoC planning: choose the existing vehicle percentage sensor, e.g. sensor.audi_soc.
data_description.soc_source_mode: OEM: fresh vehicle data only. Manual: explicit user-entered value. Meter compensated: OEM plus actual energy meter with marked Estimated status.
data_description.manual_soc: Explicit SoC when the vehicle cloud is unavailable; not presented as OEM measurement.
data_description.charge_efficiency: Required for meter compensation: evidence-based battery kWh / grid kWh ratio, e.g. 0.9 if verified.
data_description.battery_kwh: Required for SoC-driven planning: usable battery capacity in kWh, e.g. 20 kWh. Do not guess gross capacity.

data.name: Charger name (required)
data.control_entity: Native charging control entity (required for Start/Stop)
data.nominal_phase_voltage_v: Nominal supply voltage per phase (V); required to derive power from a current limit
data.connection_source: Connected source: HA sensor or manual
data.price_mode: Tariff source: effective price or market spot

data_description.control_entity: Required for physical charging: select the original EVSE or EV-rated smart-plug switch/input_boolean. V2 only commands with an explicitly enabled Controller, exclusive ownership and actual readback.
data_description.connected_entity: Required when Connected source = Sensor. Pick the native cable/vehicle-connected entity. Manual mode instead gives a separate Connected Yes/No switch.
data_description.charging_entity: Choose the actual charging status sensor (sensor or binary_sensor).
data_description.power_entity: Required for physical control: real Charger power entity in W/kW, e.g. sensor.peblar_charge_power. Not total household power.
data_description.energy_entity: For actual session kWh and costs: select the real kWh/Wh meter of this charging point, including total-increasing meters. The meter kind below controls safe per-connection accounting.
data_description.tariff_entity: Required for price-based planning: an entity with a verified future effective EUR/kWh curve or market curve plus explicit costs. A scalar current spot price is not enough.
data_description.connection_source: Choose Manual for smart plugs without a cable sensor. A separate Connected Yes/No switch appears on the V2 Charger device.
data_description.requested_grid_kwh: Optional grid energy when no reliable SoC is available. Choose kWh OR duration, not both.
data_description.requested_duration_quarters: Optional number of 15-minute periods without reliable SoC. Four quarters = one hour.
data_description.charge_ready_time: Daily ready deadline for charging without Vehicle/SoC, e.g. 08:00.
data_description.energy_source_kind: Session resets each session. Total increasing is a lifetime meter; V2 uses only witnessed increments since the operator-declared connection. Unknown meter kinds never produce invented session energy.
data_description.price_mode: Effective slots use verified all-in EUR/kWh source slots. Spot with fees accepts Nord Pool/Frank/ENTSO-e-style arrays only after explicit cost and VAT confirmation.
data_description.spot_markup_eur_kwh: Required in spot mode: known per-kWh supplier, network and levy costs combined; can be negative for a discount. No assumed zero.
data_description.price_vat_percent: Required in spot mode: correct VAT on spot plus adjustments. Verify whether source values already contain VAT.
data_description.max_ac_kw: Required for physical execution and SoC-free planning: known continuous charger rating, e.g. 2.0 kW for an EV-rated smart plug. Never infer a rating from present idle power.
data_description.controller_uid: Required: choose the existing V2 Charge Controller responsible for this Charger's planning and electrical budget.

data.name: Controller name (required)
data.cost_budget_eur: Hard cost cap per active connection (€) — optional
data.physical_enabled: Enable real V2 charging control (requires exclusive EVSE ownership)

data_description.physical_enabled: Optional, off by default. Enable only once V1 Local no longer commands this EVSE and connected/power, effective prices, native control and Start/Stop readback are verified.
data_description.peak_shaving_enabled: Constrain EV charging to observed net household import with stable recovery. Requires site meter and power target.
data_description.site_power_entity: Choose signed net site import/export. Positive = import, negative = export. Not an EV-only meter.
data_description.peak_target_kw: Target household import capacity, e.g. 8 kW. No assumed electrical limit.
data_description.peak_reserve_kw: Additional buffer below the limit, e.g. 0.5 kW.
data_description.cost_budget_eur: Applies across currently connected charging sessions, not an automatic daily budget. V2 measures energy and effective tariff, reserving the next 15 minutes conservatively. Missing meter/price coverage blocks physical Start. Leave empty for no cap.

v2_migrate.title: Step 1 · Choose the original charger
v2_migrate.description: The original charger and its configuration will remain unchanged.

v2_migrate_confirm.title: Step 3 · Review and create V2 Charger
v2_migrate_confirm.description: Source: {legacy_name}. Original Ready By: {legacy_ready_by} (Vehicle suggestion only). Missing mappings: {missing_sources}. Only a new logical V2 Charger is created. Original Local charging remains active and V2 physical actuation stays disabled. Configure remaining mappings later in V2 Charger Options.

data_description.connected_entity: Choose the cable-connected sensor (sensor or binary_sensor).

v2_migrate_bindings.title: Step 2 · Link existing V2 devices
v2_migrate_bindings.description: Select an existing Charge Controller and optionally an available Vehicle. Create new ones through Add V2 devices.

v2_migrate_target.title: Choose the V2 Charger
v2_migrate_target.description: Create a new V2 Charger or link an existing V2 Charger with no V1 source.

v2_migrate_existing_confirm.title: Confirm existing Charger link
v2_migrate_existing_confirm.description: Link {legacy_name} to existing V2 Charger {v2_name}. Existing V2 configuration stays authoritative; only missing source bindings are filled. Original Local charging remains unchanged, and no V2 charging commands are issued.

v2_vehicle_source.title: Select existing HA vehicle device
v2_vehicle_source.description: Optionally select a native Home Assistant device. Only uniquely matching source entities are suggested; review each mapping. Leave blank for manual configuration.

v2_charger_source.title: Select existing HA charger device
v2_charger_source.description: Optionally select a native Home Assistant device. Only uniquely matching source entities are suggested; review each mapping. Leave blank for manual configuration.

v2_import_intermediate.title: Old interim Controller → V2
v2_import_intermediate.description: Review existing interim policy or Vehicle. This does not modify original Local V1, any source Config Entry or the old Controller. Review all values and source quality before enabling physical control.

add_vehicle.description: Configure one Vehicle using Home Assistant entities; no car-brand integration required.

assign_vehicle.title: Assign Vehicle to Charger
assign_vehicle.description: Each Charger can select a Vehicle or None. This selection does not change original Local physical control.

delete_vehicle.title: Choose Vehicle to delete
delete_vehicle.description: Deletion does not change the Local charger configuration.

confirm_delete_vehicle.title: Confirm Vehicle deletion
confirm_delete_vehicle.description: Delete {vehicle} and clear its assignment? Its EVSC entities and device are removed on Controller reload. Local charging continues unchanged.

link_chargers.title: Link Chargers
link_chargers.description: Link existing Chargers to the Charge Controller while retaining their native Local execution.

v2_options.title: Configure V2 device
v2_options.description: Configure this V2 device. Choose existing Home Assistant entities. Clear an optional selection to unlink it. Original Local charging is unchanged.
